race.comment: PARADOXIUM (1) sent to Victoria first up with a slick on pace win over 1100m in the G3 Poseidon Stakes at Flemington with plenty up the sleeve. Gets the right set-up again and should prove too sharp for these. SATONO GLOW (14) asserted her class first up from back in the field with a dominant win in the G3 Cap D'Antibes Stakes over 1100m at Flemington. Since kept up to the mark with a strong trial win over 800m at Hawkesbury. Awkward draw but hard to ignore winning form. BLESSED EAGLE (5) progressing well in his first prep and deserves his shot at this level with the two wins from three outings. Maps well and sure to be thereabouts. CASTILLO KING (3) races best with his runs spaced and can't draw a decent gate. Taken to the front from the outside barrier with a tidy fifth over this course and distance in the G2 Run To The Rose. Place only. STEEL WILL (7) had no luck at Flemington in the Poseidon Stakes and maps well today. Value contender.
